note: Iveco builds no petrol vehicles, yet all 44 of its engine codes were recorded as essence on a generic approval. Three families: the Sofim 8140/8149 2.5-2.8 indirect-injection units in the older Daily, the F1A 2.3 JTD and F1C 3.0 JTD common-rail units in the Daily from 2006, and their Euro 6 F1AFL/F1CFL/F1CFA successors. The common-rail units run a particulate filter from Euro 5, which makes their low-SAPS grade a requirement; the Sofim units predate it and take a conventional 15W-40 that suits Tunisian temperatures. Capacities are family figures rather than manual ones.

engines.source: F1AFL411 (2.3) and F1CFL411 / F1CFA401 (3.0) - the Euro 6 Daily. Particulate filter and SCR fitted, so the low-SAPS grade is a requirement.
F1CE 3.0 JTD - Daily 35C/50C/70C and Eurocargo. The larger of the two common-rail fours.
F1AE 2.3 JTD - Daily 29L/35S, and the same unit Fiat fits to the Ducato.

Sofim 8140 and 8149 2.5 and 2.8 indirect-injection diesels - the older Daily, and shared with the Fiat Ducato and Renault Master of the same era. No particulate filter, so a conventional 15W-40 is correct and suits hot climates.
